name: Sal Celtica - Antojos de Medianoche V3
master_prompt: Create ONE vertical 9:16 Spanish short-form UGC clip with native spoken audio for Sal Celtica. Each clip is one leaf scene only: one location, one camera setup, one visual idea, one exact spoken line. Tone: urgent, natural, relatable, midnight-kitchen realism, not polished advertising. Keep claims framed as educational/marketing narrative, not medical advice. No miracle cures, no disease claims, no fake doctor language, no social UI, no captions baked into generated video.

hooks.title: Tu cuerpo tiene sed de minerales

hooks.subject_placement_hint: person opening the fridge or pantry at night with a tiny dish of off-white translucent flaky sea salt crystals visible nearby as the relevant mineral alternative; no product packaging or readable brands
hooks.script: Tu cuerpo no tiene hambre, tiene sed de minerales.
hooks.prompt: First-frame thumbnail for a Spanish UGC reel: a tired person in a lived-in kitchen at midnight opens the fridge and reaches for random snacks, while a tiny ceramic dish of off-white translucent flaky sea salt crystals sits on the counter as the contrast object. The salt must match the attached grain reference: irregular fractured flakes, semi-translucent off-white crystals, dry coarse flakes, not gray gravel, not round pebbles. Phone-camera realism, slightly messy kitchen, fridge light spilling into the dark room, sleepy expression, snack wrappers or leftovers in the background but no readable brands. The frame should instantly communicate late-night cravings and mineral thirst. Do not show any product packaging, logos, labels, or fake branded containers. Native dialogue: Tu cuerpo no tiene hambre, tiene sed de minerales.
